projectSummary: A dose-like relationship between bench angle and clavicular-head activation, measured with exercise-specific loads. Consistent in direction with the inclination studies above.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Abstract-only; fifteen male subjects; the exercise is described as a chest press rather than a barbell bench press specifically.

study.intervention: flat bench press at 0 degrees; 28, 44 and 56 degrees
study.population: Fifteen healthy male subjects performed the chest press at 0 (flat bench), 28, 44 and 56 degrees above horizontal, using 70 per cent of their respective one-repetition maximum for each angle, while EMG was recorded.

title: An electromyography analysis of 3 muscles surrounding the shoulder joint during the performance of a chest press exercise at several angles.
